newsitem.title: USA: Radisys to acquire Sonitech International.
newsitem.headline: Radisys to acquire Sonitech International.

text.p: RadiSys Corp Wednesday said it agreed to acquire Sonitech International Inc, a provider of digital signal processing hardware and software solutions for embedded applications.

Under the agreement, RadiSys will exchange 83,500 shares of RadiSys common stock and approximately $1 million in cash for all the assets and certain of the trade liabilities of Sonitech International.
For the year ended December 31, 1996, Sonitech had unaudited revenues of approximately $3 million and break even earnings.
The Sonitech business will become a new division of RadiSys focused on embedded DSP applications.
